topic: One sea scallop cooked in a warm fine-dining kitchen: hot-pan sear, brown-butter basting, lemon sauce, careful plating, and service to one guest. Same scallop, chef hands, copper pan, white plate, and kitchen across six visibly moving shots.
style: photoreal cinematic food film, warm tungsten light, macro lens, rich natural texture
requestedEnding: The guest cuts the plated scallop to reveal its moist center and takes one satisfying bite.

storyArc.goal: To perfectly cook and plate the scallop for a guest.
storyArc.obstacle: Achieving the ideal sear and moist interior without overcooking.
storyArc.turn: The chef adjusts the heat and bastes with brown butter and lemon, carefully monitoring the scallop’s color and texture.
storyArc.visualBible: Photorealistic, cinematic food film. Warm tungsten lighting. Macro lens emphasizing texture. Rich natural colors. Focus on the transformation of the scallop from raw to perfectly cooked. Consistent use of copper pan and white plate. Six visibly moving shots, showcasing the scallop's journey.

ideas.title: Prep & Sear
ideas.angle: Close-up: Chef's hands expertly pat dry a single sea scallop, prepping it for the hot pan. Focus on texture.

ideas.title: Copper's Embrace
ideas.angle: Medium shot: The scallop hits the searing copper pan, immediate sizzle and browning. Camera follows the Maillard reaction.

ideas.title: Brown Butter's Magic
ideas.angle: Close-up: Chef bastes the scallop with bubbling brown butter, the aroma visually suggested by the steam.

ideas.title: Lemon's Kiss
ideas.angle: Medium shot: A squeeze of lemon juice over the scallop, highlighting the bright acidity. Focus on the sauce's sheen.

ideas.title: Plating Precision
ideas.angle: Overhead shot: Chef carefully plates the scallop on a pristine white plate, showcasing the color contrast.

plan.title: The Golden Scallop
plan.hook: One scallop. Thirty seconds to a perfect golden crust.
plan.payoff: The guest cuts the plated scallop to reveal its moist center and takes one satisfying bite.

shots.narration: One scallop. Thirty seconds to a perfect golden crust.

The scallop's texture is prominent, with visible ridges and a slightly damp surface. Soft, warm tungsten light illuminates the scene, highlighting the scallop's natural color. Consistent subject: The sea scallop. Visual style: photoreal cinematic food film, warm tungsten light, macro lens, rich natural texture.
shots.motionPrompt: The chef's hands, clad in white gloves, swiftly and decisively pat the sea scallop dry with a clean linen towel, pressing firmly to remove excess moisture, ending with the scallop perfectly dry and ready for the pan; the camera smoothly tracks the hand movements from a slightly angled perspective, maintaining focus on the scallop’s surface. One continuous take, no cuts.

shots.narration: The chef plates it, ready for the final test.

A glossy brown-butter lemon sauce pools beside it; no other scallops, no text, no extra hands. Rich natural food texture, shallow depth of field.
